title: When and Why Consumers Avoid Purchase on Smartphones
authors: Vincentia Yuen, Claudia Townsend, Michael Tsiros

package_source.dataset_title: Replication Data for When and Why Consumers Avoid Purchase on Smartphones

eligible_reason: Experiments plus two aggregated field datasets: Study 6 (company Google Analytics export comparing buy-to-detail rates by device and product category, cross-sectional) and Study 7 (aggregated Facebook A/B test report). No panel, no DiD.
design_notes: Zip extracted: per-study folders (Pilot, 1-9B) with Qualtrics .qsf, raw data zips, SPSS .sav/.sps, Colab notebooks, preregistrations.
screener_notes: Ruled out from the abstract, README and data descriptions.
main_text_note: Article confirms experiments plus field evidence from online sales data by device (Study 6) and a Facebook field experiment; no DiD terms.
